fields.subnational_unit: 34 African countries, subnational regions (pixel-level maps for Ghana, Ethiopia, Kenya, South Africa)
fields.population: households in DHS surveys of 34 African countries (more than 700,000 households; latest survey 2007-2018, mostly 2016-2018)
fields.sample_size: more than 700,000 households in 34 countries (DHS); nine countries with subnational COVID-19 case data for validation
fields.effect_measure: physical distancing index (share of households without private toilet, private water, space, transport and communication technology, weighted by population density) with Bayesian small-area estimation; correlation with detected COVID-19 cases
fields.effect_estimate: The index is high in western Africa; 45% of households share toilets (on average with two other households; 1.32 in Mozambique to 6.17 in Ghana); 40% rely on a public water source. Correlation between the index and subnational detected COVID-19 cases ranges 0.4-0.9 across nine countries. The paper frames missing domestic infrastructure as undermining governmental distancing regulations; no legal or institutional exposure is evaluated.
fields.model_type: Bayesian small-area estimation and index construction
fields.study_design: cross-sectional multi-country household-survey index study with spatial risk mapping
fields.section: Full text (Nature Communications 13:3355): Results; Discussion; Methods (DHS data, index, Bayesian regression)
fields.exact_location: Results p2-5; Discussion p6-8; Methods p8-10

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a physical-distancing infrastructure index built from DHS data for 34 African countries (>700,000 households), read in full text 2026-10-04. Households lacking private toilets, water, space, transport and communication are concentrated in western Africa; the index correlates 0.4-0.9 with detected COVID-19 cases subnationally. Descriptive and ecological; no legal or administrative exposure.
pdf_note: Nature Communications 13:3355 (2022), about 63,000 characters read; figures and supplementary information not read
notes: Abstract-level extraction accurate; adds n and the descriptive figures. SCOPE/FIT QUESTION: index construction with no legal or institutional exposure (boolean flags such as water_access only); JBI cross-sectional rating left for reclassification (A11) and eligibility for the legal-last-mile question is arguable (A12).
